question: With the standalone fallback stage and the complete-bundle stage measured separately, does the shipped code make a writer abort visible on the bundle a reader actually receives: answer.degradation carries the code and disclosure, the adversarial pass inherits it and marks itself DEGRADED (or VACUOUS when the answer has no legal vocabulary), the product's own degradation_visibility() reports visible=true at the complete-bundle stage, and a healthy leg stays non-degraded?
why_v2: V1 predicted that product/answer_reliability.py::degradation_visibility() would already report visible=true on the bare output of pipeline._extractive_degraded_fallback(). It does not, and the result was recorded verbatim as DEGRADATION_DISCLOSURE_GAP. Source inspection shows the V1 sub-check was stage-blind, not that the product is silent: degradation_visibility (product/answer_reliability.py lines 425-429) defines visible for an aborted writer as code present AND the adversarial pass marked WRITER_ABORT/DEGRADED/VACUOUS. In the shipped pipeline the fallback is built at pipeline.py:1256 and the adversarial pass is run afterwards at pipeline.py:1288, so at the fallback stage there is no new adversarial_status to read; the recorded pre-fix bundle's old adversarial_retrieval block has no adversarial_status at all. The complete-bundle stage is the reader-visible stage (enrich_query_bundle returns only after the pass). V2 therefore splits the one mis-specified sub-check: G1 no longer requires product_visibility.visible (it still requires degraded=true and the code), while G2 keeps and requires visible=true on the complete bundle. No other gate, control, exit code or claim ceiling is relaxed.
why_this_is_not_gate_shopping: The V1 failure is preserved byte-for-byte in the committed result and is reported as a negative result. The change is a single derived sub-check whose expected value was contradicted by the shipped call order, and the correction is justified from source lines committed before the V2 freeze. The V2 hypothesis predicts the same four substantive gates and adds a control (C6) that the V1 result still exists with its original digest and verdict. If V2 fails any gate, it is reported as a gap and is not re-frozen again in this cycle.
hypothesis: On the recorded pre-fix degraded bundle (CYCLE_39667945530_bundle.json) and the recorded healthy bundle (CYCLE_39667945530_FIX1_bundle.json), the shipped code at accepted product mount head fe219a19 satisfies: (G1) the extractive fallback stamps answer.degradation with code e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, stage generative_writer, a disclosure containing both 'not measured' and 'contrary authority', mirrors it under provenance.generative_audit.degradation with emission_status WRITER_ABORT and degraded=true, preserves the recorded provider_error verbatim, preserves all 151 decisions, does not mutate its input, and the product's own degradation_visibility() reports degraded=true and the abort code; the standalone-stage visible flag is RECORDED but not gated because the pass has not run yet; (G2) the subsequent offline adversarial pass (max_new=0, hydrate_top=0) publishes degraded=true, degradation_code e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, an adversarial_status containing WRITER_ABORT, a measurement-gap disclosure, preserves every decision and the answer's degradation, and degradation_visibility() now reports visible=true; (G3) a derived empty-prose bundle takes the vacuous branch with skipped=true, adversarial_status VACUOUS_WRITER_ABORT and the inherited code; (G4) the healthy bundle stays MEASURED with no writer-abort code, answer.status ready, and degradation_visibility() visible=true and degraded=false.
baseline: the same two recorded bundles and the same accepted product mount head fe219a19 as V1. The V1 result (digest 4b9bc432...) is a pinned input, not a baseline to beat: V2 does not score V1, it re-runs the complete-bundle predicates with the stage split disclosed.

gates.G1_abort_is_a_first_class_answer_field: same checks as V1 EXCEPT product_visibility_visible is reported as a stage observation and is not a gate condition; product_visibility_degraded=true and product_visibility_code=e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT are required
gates.G2_adversarial_pass_inherits_the_abort: same as V1, including product_visibility_visible=true on the complete bundle

controls.C1_deleting_the_answer_field_fails_G1: removing answer.degradation from an in-memory copy of the G1 output must fail the G1 gate
controls.C2_relabelling_the_pass_as_measured_fail: setting degraded=false, code=null and status=MEASURED on the G2 output must fail the G2 gate
controls.C3_injecting_an_abort_into_the_healthy_l: injecting the abort fields into the healthy pass output must fail the G4 gate
controls.C4_network_guard_is_armed_and_unused: the socket guard must raise when exercised and record zero attempts during the product calls
controls.C5_product_and_input_pins_hold_before_an: the six product/bundle pins hold before and after; inputs are unchanged
controls.C6_v1_result_is_preserved_verbatim: the V1 result file still hashes to 4b9bc432... and still carries verdict DEGRADATION_DISCLOSURE_GAP with exit_code 1

population: the two recorded bundle files only. No new retrieval, bundle, packet, label or geometry.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: on the recorded degraded and healthy bundles, the shipped code's writer-abort disclosure is visible and machine-readable at the complete-bundle stage, is inherited by the adversarial pass, is correctly vacuous without legal vocabulary, and is not raised on the healthy leg; the standalone fallback stage reports degraded=true and the code but degradation_visibility().visible remains false there because the pass has not yet run, and that stage-specific limitation is disclosed. It is NOT a retrieval-quality, counter-authority recall, live-answer reliability, served-packet, label or geometry measurement; it does not meet or move any frozen bar (both stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet on the v3 bytes), lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order, and changes no admission or human gate. All five admission/human flags stay false. No frontier candidate is built or scored and no universal-174k benchmark is run. NOT_APPLICABLE/NOT_MEASURED are never a pass.
freeze_first_disclosure: V1 was frozen and executed first; its failure is preserved and is the reason for this V2. V2's corrected stage split, controls and exit contract are fixed BEFORE the V2 instrument executes. No substantive gate is relaxed: the complete-bundle visibility requirement that V1 placed prematurely on G1 is enforced on G2 and G4. If V2 fails, it is reported, not re-frozen in this cycle.
network_policy: zero network; offline adversarial pass with max_new=0 under an armed socket guard
determinism: fixed bytes, deterministic code paths, no RNG/model/retrieval/threshold
